observations.initial_guest_screen: Windows displayed a restart-apps confirmation listing UTM Guest Tools Installer, Network File Explorer, and Task Manager.
observations.action: Cancelled the guest restart prompt; did not use UTM stop, pause, or restart controls.

current_read_only_screen_check.guest_command_result: UTM reported OSStatus -2700: Failed to execute child process (No such file or directory); no guest output returned.

recheck.restart_confirmation: UTM warned that its Restart control resets the VM and loses unsaved changes.
recheck.after_reset_display: UEFI boot manager appeared briefly, then UTM displayed 'Display output is not active' and a black screen.
recheck.after_reset_ping: 192.168.64.6 did not reply to one ICMP probe.
recheck.later_network_recheck: utmctl ip-address returned IPv4 192.168.64.6 and IPv6 addresses; the display remained inactive.
recheck.read_only_utmctl_exec: PowerShell query failed with OSStatus -10004 before guest output.
recheck.z_package_read: An earlier utmctl file pull of the staged Windows package terminated with signal 6 and produced a zero-byte host file. After the user-approved reset, one read-only pull of C:\Windows\win.ini also terminated with signal 6 (exit 134).
recheck.temporary_guest_probe: A command was issued to create C:\Windows\Temp\ac-utm-probe-20261024.txt. The subsequent read and cleanup attempts terminated with signal 6; whether the marker exists is unverified.
recheck.host_share_listing: macOS returned Operation not permitted for the supplied host folder.

result: The user-approved VM reset was triggered. UTM reports started and utmctl later returned IPv4 192.168.64.6 plus IPv6 addresses, but the display remains inactive and a read-only guest file pull aborts with signal 6 (exit 134). Windows desktop access, Z: visibility, and package execution remain unverified. No Windows build or package run occurred.
